description: This file defines the TenantClient interface for the Eclipse Hono project, providing methods to retrieve tenant configuration information via various identifiers such as tenant ID, subject DN, and with optional tracing context.

classes.name: TenantClient
classes.description: Interface for accessing Hono's Tenant API, extending RequestResponseClient with methods to fetch tenant configuration data, supporting tracing context where applicable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on tenant ID, returning a Future with TenantObject, succeeded if successful, failed with ServiceInvocationException otherwise.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method to retrieve tenant information, same as get(String), with optional OpenTracing span context for tracing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on the subject DN (X500Principal), returning a Future with TenantObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method to retrieve tenant information based on subject DN with tracing context, which calls the get(X500Principal) method.
